THINGS_MAGIC_GLOVE.title: Severed Sleeve
THINGS_MAGIC_GLOVE.description: Upon pickup, choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Deck[/gold] to [gold]Transform[/gold] into [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Flash of Steel[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Finesse[/gold], then lose [blue]{HpLoss}[/blue] Max HP.
THINGS_MAGIC_GLOVE.eventDescription: Choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Deck[/gold] to [gold]Transform[/gold] into [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Flash of Steel[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Finesse[/gold]. Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] Max HP.
THINGS_MAGIC_GLOVE.flavor: There's just a blade hidden inside.
THINGS_WHITE_FLAG.title: White Flag
THINGS_WHITE_FLAG.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Surrender[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [red]Shame[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
THINGS_CURSE_REMOVER.title: Yellow Talisman
THINGS_CURSE_REMOVER.description: Upon pickup, lose [blue]{HpLoss}[/blue] HP. The first [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [red]{Cards:plural:Curse|Curses}[/red] you obtain are [gold]Enchanted[/gold] with [purple]Disperse[/purple].
THINGS_CURSE_REMOVER.eventDescription: Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP. The first [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [red]{Cards:plural:Curse|Curses}[/red] you obtain are [gold]Enchanted[/gold] with [purple]Disperse[/purple].
THINGS_CURSE_REMOVER.flavor: The only answer comes from yourself, a thousand years ago...
THINGS_ALMOND_WATER.title: Almond Water
THINGS_ALMOND_WATER.description: At the start of normal, [gold]Elite[/gold], or [gold]Boss[/gold] combats, gain [blue]{NormalRegen}[/blue], [blue]{EliteRegen}[/blue], or [blue]{BossRegen}[/blue] [gold]Regen[/gold], respectively.
THINGS_ALMOND_WATER.flavor: This water is healing your mind.
THINGS_MEDUSA_HAIR.title: Medusa's Hair
THINGS_MEDUSA_HAIR.description: At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Stone Armor+[/gold] and a [gold]Giant Rock+[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. They are free to play this combat, and [gold]Giant Rock+[/gold] gains [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
THINGS_MEDUSA_HAIR.flavor: Off her head, the snakes finally stop arguing.
THINGS_SHADOW_CLAIM_TICKET.title: Claim Ticket
THINGS_SHADOW_CLAIM_TICKET.description: Before this Act's [gold]Boss[/gold] combat, return the stored card to your [gold]Deck[/gold] [gold]Upgraded[/gold].
THINGS_BOTTLED_ECHO.title: Bottled Echo
THINGS_BOTTLED_ECHO.description: At the start of the next {Combats:plural:combat|[blue]{}[/blue] combats}, add a copy of the stored card into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this combat and has [gold]Exhaust[/gold] and [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
THINGS_BOTTLED_ECHO.flavor: Some moves, the well remembers better than you do.
THINGS_MYCELIAL_DEPOSIT.title: Mycelial Deposit
THINGS_MYCELIAL_DEPOSIT.shortTerms: At the end of the next {Payments:plural:combat|[blue]{}[/blue] combats}, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
THINGS_MYCELIAL_DEPOSIT.longTerms: After defeating this Act's [gold]Boss[/gold], gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP.
THINGS_BORROWED_EMBER.title: Ember Pact
THINGS_BORROWED_EMBER.debtTerms: You cannot choose any options at your next [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
THINGS_BORROWED_EMBER.kindledTerms: When you enter your next [gold]Rest Site[/gold], heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
THINGS_BORROWED_EMBER.flavor: Some fires have already burned for you.
THINGS_ANESTHETIC_CHART.title: Anesthetic Chart
THINGS_ANESTHETIC_CHART.description: At the start of the next {Combats:plural:combat|[blue]{}[/blue] combats}, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] fewer {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
THINGS_RETURN_RECEIPT.title: Return Receipt
THINGS_RETURN_RECEIPT.flavor: Fine print on the back reads: Exchanges processed strictly for scrap weight, never sentiment.
THINGS_RETURN_RECEIPT.description: You may [gold]Return[/gold] card rewards to gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
THINGS_NARROW_VIEWFINDER.title: Narrow Viewfinder
THINGS_NARROW_VIEWFINDER.flavor: Cut half the frame away, and everything left inside looks hand-picked.
THINGS_NARROW_VIEWFINDER.description: Card rewards contain [blue]1[/blue] fewer card. [gold]Rare[/gold] card odds are doubled, and all card rewards are [gold]Upgraded[/gold].
THINGS_HOT_WAX_PARCEL.title: Hot Wax Parcel
THINGS_HOT_WAX_PARCEL.flavor: The wax is still warm enough to sting your fingers, impatient to burst open.
THINGS_HOT_WAX_PARCEL.description:
Win [blue]2[/blue] combats within the next [blue]3[/blue] rooms to open the parcel for [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and a random [gold]Rare Relic[/gold]. Otherwise, lose [blue]{Damage}[/blue] HP and obtain a random [red]Curse[/red].

{Status}
THINGS_HOT_WAX_PARCEL.statusExpired: Cracked: Wax seal ruptured along the way.
THINGS_CHILLED_WAX_PARCEL.title: Chilled Wax Parcel
THINGS_CHILLED_WAX_PARCEL.flavor: Packed under crushed ice, even the deadline ticks at half speed.
THINGS_CHILLED_WAX_PARCEL.description:
Defeat [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Elite[/gold] within the next [blue]4[/blue] rooms to [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Deck[/gold] and gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Expires harmlessly.

{Status}
THINGS_AMBER_COMB_CORE.title: Amber Comb Core
THINGS_AMBER_COMB_CORE.description: At the start of your first {Turns:plural:turn|[blue]{}[/blue] turns}, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
THINGS_AMBER_COMB_CORE.flavor: Even before the honey sets, the hum inside the comb already beats twice as fast.
